notes: PASS means this single browser lookup worked and no explicit prohibition was found in the displayed verification terms; not legal clearance or reliability testing. One CVS/AUSTIN name search followed by one numeric permit search; number search navigated directly to detail without a second click. Name results loaded asynchronously. Detail states disciplinary-order information is current as of 30 days prior, orders older than 10 years are not online, and certain orders are confidential. Do not equate No with no historical discipline. Exact URL observed above; session-cookie dependence and initial-response-vs-JavaScript split not tested. Raw pharmacy detail includes incidental employee names/license links; no individual license was searched or opened; do not use employee numbers as demo input.
